name: Animate Wood — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Animate Wood from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Animate Wood" but are not part of the Animate Wood entry, which is unchanged.

School transmutation; Level druid 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (piece of unworked oak)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one Small or smaller wooden object
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell imbues a Small or smaller wooden object as an Animated Object, then causes it to immediately attack whomever or whatever you initially designate. Objects animated by this spell have hardness 5. If you attempt to affect an attended object, the object or its attendee receives a Will save and spell resistance applies.
